dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: This research looks promising, indeed... But I could really do with someone to help me out.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: Huh? Me? I'm Liouba, an engineer with the Fontaine Research Institute. I'm using these robots to collect data on fluid impact forces.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: This is quite the departure from my previous sphere of research — a few years ago, I was conducting research into cosmetic devices with my colleague, Lelienne.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: However... How should I put this? After seeing the prototype she put together, I was suddenly inspired to look into impact-focused battle meks. A researcher's path is seldom straight or simple.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: See you. Take care on the road.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with this treasure chest over here?

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: A little reward for anyone willing to assist with my research! And it can be yours, so long as you don't mind helping with four different data collection scenarios.
